snippets: GM Javokhir Sindarov earned his shot at the title with a dominant, unbeaten 10/14 score at the 2026 Candidates Tournament, the best showing in the event's modern history. The Tashkent native became a grandmaster at just 12 years old and the youngest-ever Chess World Cup champion in 2025. Watch two hours of the Chess.com Twitch channel during the match to unlock Gukesh and Sindarov flairs! Follow on Twitch ... The Salesforce FIDE World Chess Championship takes place in Geneva, Switzerland.

Magnus Carlsen is not playing in the 2026 Salesforce FIDE World Chess Championship because he announced in 2022 that he would not defend his classical world title after winning his fifth championship match in 2021.

GM Gukesh Dommaraju became the youngest World Champion in history in 2024, defeating GM Ding Liren in Singapore. The 2026 match will produce the youngest title clash ever contested, with both Gukesh and challenger GM Javokhir Sindarov turning 20 during the event.

His decision opened the way for Ding Liren to become World Champion in 2023, before Gukesh Dommaraju won the title in 2024. The 2026 match therefore features defending champion Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov, who earned the right to challenge him by winning the 2026 Candidates Tournament.
